A quick list of what we learned. We currently only have a transcript and an audio recording.

  • Presentation was 20 mins long. Official video to be released "soon".
  • Fallout Shelter for android: August 13th. Comes with large update for all version including new enemies, attacks and Mr Handy etc.
  • Promotional videos talking about each of the SPECIAL stats will be released between now and game release.
  • Over 1000 character names voiced, they are comprised of the most common names AND names Bethesda think players would like. McFly, Boobies and... Fuckface confirmed. Codsworth says them with completely professionalism.
  • 12 companions, 4 confirmed to be Dogmeat, Codsworth, Preston Garvey (the Minuteman encountered in the Power Armour section) and Piper, a female journalist located outside Diamond City.
  • All (human) companions can be romanced. No dog or robot sex. Modding will fix.
  • Looting doesn't pause game or take up entire screen. Pipboy still pauses screen.
  • Revamped quick selection. New grenade hotkey too.
  • Ghouls can climb through windows and drop from ledges. Implied to be awesome and scary. Will use this to chase you.
  • Explosive barrels exist
  • Lexington is a town full of feral ghouls after recently pushing out all survivors.
  • You fight in a Corvega factory within Lexington. Seems to also have a power plant.
  • Melee attacks with ranged weapons shown, finishers for melee in Vats.
  • Over 70 perks with 3-4 ranks. It has its own menu UI.
  • Skills seem to be like Skyrim, use them to improve them.
  • Dogmeat can wear a scarf
  • Hacking minigame is very similar to old
